<description>
This PR is part of integrating silent payments into Bitcoin Core. It is the second iteration of https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/28122, now based on https://github.com/bitcoin-core/secp256k1/pull/1765.

This project is tracked in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/28536.

BIP352
This PR focuses strictly on the BIP logic and attempts to separate it from the wallet and transaction implementation details. This is accomplished by working directly with public and private keys, instead of needing a wallet backend and transactions for testing. Labels for the receiver are optional and thus deferred for a later PR.

Test vectors from the BIP are included as unit tests.
</description>

[2026-09-18] rc:4051144344 inline on src/common/bip352.cpp by theStack (member) (edited 2026-09-18):
in 7e0cc68ecaa7d69cd4c04c5ecf6a643bda9b898d: `SilentPaymentsReceiver::Scan`:
the spend pubkey doesn't change between multiple `.Scan` calls of a `SilentPaymentsReceiver` instance, so it's sufficient to only parse it once directly in the constructor; doing it repeatedly for each transaction could hurt scanning performance noticeably (especially if its parsing a compressed pubkey; a minimum-diff improvement for now would be to simply call `.Decompress()` in the ctor, then the most expensive part is already done, as parsing an uncompressed pubkey is significantly faster).
